verdict.rationale: A runtime probe confirms from the npm registry that three.js is MIT-licensed. MIT is a permissive open-source license that imposes no royalties or per-install fees, so the studio keeps its game revenue. missing for 10: first-party LICENSE text or license documentation in the pack, an explicit statement of no royalties or fees, independent community corroboration of commercial use terms.

support.subject: As a studio lead, the license is permissive with no royalties or per-install fees — I keep what my game earns

citations.quote: MIT license verified from the registry.
